title: Count Arc-enabled servers per wave with Azure Resource Graph
summary: A cross-subscription Resource Graph query that lists every Arc machine with status, OS and tags, so a wave is only closed when counts match.
code:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| project name, resourceGroup, location,
          status = tostring(properties.status),
          os = tostring(properties.osName),
          tags
| order by resourceGroup asc, name asc
notes: Run it in Resource Graph Explorer or with az graph query -q; portal views are per subscription and filter.
Machines missing from the result are failures, not 'pending'.
